notes: MXCW640 is the wireless "Conference Unit" component of Shure's modular Microflex Complete Wireless (MXCW) system (the system also includes the separate MXCWAPT access-point transceiver and MXCWNCS networked charging station, not covered here). Specs cross-checked against Shure's official MXCW User Guide (www.shure.com/en-US/docs/guide/MXCW), the B&H Photo product/specs page (bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1467057-REG), and Shure's product page (www.shure.com/en-US/products/wireless-systems/mxcw/mxcw640). Physical I/O is entirely audio/power (no HDMI/SDI/Ethernet), so no port on this device qualifies for a bandwidth "grade" — the RF wireless link (2.4/5 GHz, AES-128 encrypted, up to 125 units) is not a physical connector and is omitted from the port list. Desktop/handheld tabletop unit — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. The two headphone jacks are not individually labeled on the device silkscreen; "Headphone Output 1/2" is used descriptively for the pair of identical side-mounted TRRS jacks. Battery is a removable SB930 Li-ion pack (charged in-unit via USB Micro-B, or externally in the separate MXCWNCS charging station) — the external battery-station charging contacts are not part of this device's own port set.

ports.name: Microphone Connector
ports.note: Proprietary Shure locking 10-pin "modular" connector for MXC-series gooseneck microphones (MXC416/420/425/406-MS). Not a real RJ45/Ethernet jack — carries analog mic audio plus DC power to the gooseneck mic. Mapped to rj45 as the closest connector id in the allowed list.

ports.name: Headphone Output 1
ports.note: TRRS 3.5 mm jack with volume knob, one of two identical headphone outputs (one on each side of the unit) carrying floor audio or an interpretation channel.

ports.name: Headphone Output 2
ports.note: TRRS 3.5 mm jack with volume knob, second of two identical headphone outputs (opposite side of the unit).

ports.name: TRRS Port
ports.note: TRRS 3.5 mm jack for connecting a mobile phone so a remote caller can listen to and be heard over the floor mix.

ports.name: USB Micro-B Connector
ports.note: Charges the installed SB930 rechargeable battery while it remains in the unit. Charging-only port; no USB data speed is specified, so no grade is set.
